newsitem.title: UK: Zinc set for deficits in 1997/1998 - Asarco CEO.
newsitem.headline: Zinc set for deficits in 1997/1998 - Asarco CEO.

text.p: The zinc market is heading for similar supply deficits of around 200,000 tonnes both this year and in 1998, ASARCO Inc Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard de J. Osborne said.
Asarco expects a shortfall of 217,000 tonnes of metal this year and 215,000 tonnes in 1998. This will put upward pressure on prices, Osborne said to reporters after an analysts briefing here.
At present, there is six weeks supply of metal in stocks, but the current rate of drawdowns is impressive. With those deficits looming, LME stocks could well be exhausted.
In lead, the picture is different, with only small deficits of 11,000 and 5,000 tonnes respectively likely this year and in 1998, he said.
"There is still adequate supplies and the market will trade in a narrow range," Osborne said.
